remember_session.label: Remember session (auto-refresh token)
remember_session.description: When enabled, stores a long-lived session token to automatically refresh your music token when it expires. When disabled, you must re-authenticate manually when the token expires — toggling this off after logging in immediately drops the stored long-lived tokens.

intercept_feature_enabled.label: Experimental: Enable intercept feature
intercept_feature_enabled.description: Master switch for the intercept feature. When ON, individual stations can be configured (in their player settings) to redirect Alice-initiated playback to another Music Assistant player. When OFF, intercept is fully disabled regardless of per-player settings. Requires the 'yandex_music' music provider to be configured to actually resolve tracks.

cookies.label: Browser Cookies
cookies.description: Open passport.yandex.ru/profile in your browser, use "Copy Cookies" extension to copy cookies, paste here. Supports JSON array or raw cookie string.

x_token.label: Yandex X-Token
x_token.description: Long-lived session token. Auto-obtained via login flows.

music_token.label: Yandex Music Token
music_token.description: Auto-obtained from one of the login flows.

voice_control.label: Experimental: Voice control integration
voice_control.description: Auto-resume MA queue after voice commands like 'Алиса, стоп' or 'Алиса, дальше'. Experimental — may cause unexpected behavior.

intercept_enabled.label: Experimental: Intercept native Station playback
intercept_enabled.description: When the Station starts native Yandex Music playback (typically triggered by an Alice voice command, but also a touch on the Station UI), silence the Station (setVolume 0; the Station keeps playing its own queue in the background so we see every next track) and play the same track on the chosen target player. Requires the provider-level intercept feature to be enabled and a configured 'yandex_music' music provider.

intercept_target_player_id.label: Intercept target player
intercept_target_player_id.description: Music Assistant player that receives intercepted playback. Lists every registered player except this Station; pause / volume_set / seek mirrors gracefully no-op on players that don't support them.

auth_device.label: Login with device code
auth_device.description: Open a verification URL on any device and enter the short code.

auth_qr.label: Login with QR code
auth_qr.description: Opens a QR code page — scan it with the Yandex app on your phone.

auth_cookies.label: Login with Cookies
auth_cookies.description: Authenticate using browser cookies from passport.yandex.ru.

ym_instance.label: Yandex account source
ym_instance.description: Borrow the Yandex account of a configured Yandex Music provider (single login, one token family) or use this provider's own credentials. When borrowing, authentication is managed in the linked Yandex Music provider.

manifest.description: Play music on Yandex Station smart speakers via local Glagol protocol.

device_code.title: Login to Yandex Station
device_code.hint_copy: Tap the code to copy it
device_code.copy_manual: Automatic copy failed — select the code and copy it manually
device_code.step_open: Open the Yandex page and enter the code
device_code.expired_text: The code is no longer valid. Return to Music Assistant and start the login again.
device_code.failed_text: Please return to Music Assistant and try again.
device_code.denied_text: The login was denied. Return to Music Assistant and try again.
device_code.ended_text: This login session is no longer active. You can close this window.
